Who Is the 3 BHK Buyer at Kudlu Gate?

blocks.text: What to Verify Before Booking a 3 BHK in Kudlu Gate

items: RERA registration: Demand the number and verify at rera.karnataka.gov.in — confirms approved floor plans, possession timeline, and developer disclosures
Carpet area: Always ask for RERA-confirmed carpet area, not super built-up area. These can differ by 30–40% in some projects.
Homes per floor: This single number determines corridor noise, lift wait, and community density. Lower is better.
Developer track record: Look for delivered projects and institutional clients — these signal execution capability, not just marketing.
All-inclusive cost: Ask for a cost sheet that includes base price, parking, club membership, maintenance deposit, stamp duty, registration, and GST.
Construction-linked payment plan: Ensures your payments are tied to actual delivery milestones, not arbitrary timelines.
